# p_e91b — Mara works part-time (9:00–13:00); the afternoon is for errands and gym (fork of p_07ce)

Mara works a part-time job (or a remote contract with a fixed on-site component) from 9:00 to 13:00 on weekdays. She takes the lunchbox with her to work and eats there. She returns home around 13:00, has a light snack, and heads to the gym or runs errands from roughly 15:00 to 17:00. Evenings are for stretching, TV, and winding down on the couch.

What changed from the parent: the work window is tightened to 9–13 h (not 9–14 h), so the lunchbox is OUT_OF_HOUSE only 9–13 h. The kitchen morning window is extended to 7–10 h to account for the 09:00 sightings of mug, pan, and plate at counter_k1 (she makes breakfast and a packed lunch before leaving). The tablet stays at the coffee table in the house because she leaves it home; her work does not require it.
